prompts.prompt: What is the mass of NASA’s Opportunity rover itself, in kilograms?
prompts.scope: The mass of the rover itself (dry mass), not the launch mass with the landing system.

hint.text: Opportunity was the smaller of NASA’s 2000s Mars rovers — noticeably lighter than Curiosity, which followed a decade later.

source.title: NASA Mars Exploration Rover mission (fixture-checked figure)

reveal.explanation: Opportunity’s rover body had a dry mass of about 185 kg — roughly a fifth of Curiosity’s 899 kg.

prompts.prompt: Roughly how many loaves of sandwich bread could you make from the wheat grown on one acre, using the fixture yield and a 450 g flour recipe? (The fixture uses 3,200 kg of wheat per acre, 0.75 kg of flour recovered per kg of wheat, and 0.45 kg of flour per loaf.)
prompts.scope: Demonstration fixture with declared assumptions: 3,200 kg wheat per acre, 75% extraction, 450 g flour per loaf.

steps: One acre yields 3,200 kg of wheat (declared fixture assumption).
Each loaf takes 0.45 kg: 2,400 ÷ 0.45 = 5,333.33 loaves. Worked estimate: 5,333 loaves.

reveal.explanation: 3,200 kg × 0.75 ÷ 0.45 = 5,333 loaves per acre under the declared assumptions.

prompts.prompt: Roughly how many litres of water fill a rectangular pool 25 m long, 10 m wide and 2 m deep?
prompts.scope: Rectangular pool, 25 m × 10 m × 2 m. One cubic metre holds 1,000 litres.

reveal.explanation: 25 × 10 × 2 = 500 m³, and 1 m³ = 1,000 L, so 500,000 litres — half a million bottles of water.

prompts.prompt: How many sheets of standard office paper, stacked flat, would reach the top of a 320 m tower? The fixture ream of 500 sheets is about 5 cm thick.
prompts.scope: Declared fixture paper specification: 0.05 m per 500-sheet ream (0.1 mm per sheet).

prompts.prompt: Name a feature film whose original theatrical runtime is closest to 97 minutes.
prompts.scope: Starter dataset: the fixture collection of ten films with original theatrical runtimes.

reveal.explanation: Your film’s runtime is compared against the target; the dataset’s closest eligible entries are shown.
